unit.why: A short eyewitness memorate quoted from another book: R. Elimelech of Lizhensk rebuked himself in public for sins he never committed, and many listeners repented.

stories.summary_en: The author of ד״מ testifies that R. Elimelech of Lizhensk publicly accused himself of evil deeds he never did, and many listeners understood that the words were aimed at them and repented.

quotes: שהוכיח עצמו בפני רבים באמרו ע״ע דברים רעים
tags.why: The tzaddik publicly ascribes sins to himself.
